name: The Brimstone Behemoth

source.note: The Crooked Moon (Legends of Avantris), appendix A. Numbers are the book's; the words are ours. Lair XP is 90,000 (the block lists 75,000 outside it). Cataclysmic Spellcasting is read as casting both spells in one use, once a day; the book's wording could also mean each spell once a day. The spellcasting attack +16 is worked out from Cha +8 and PB +8.

traits.name: Burning Sacrifice
traits.summary: If a creature willingly gives its life in fire or lava to defeat it, that creature can never be returned to life, and for 24 hours the behemoth has Disadvantage on D20 Tests, half Speed, Vulnerability to Radiant and no Legendary Resistance.
traits.text: When a creature willingly sacrifices its life in fire or lava to defeat the behemoth, that creature can't be returned to life by any means. For the next 24 hours the behemoth has Disadvantage on D20 Tests, its Speed is halved, it has Vulnerability to Radiant damage and it loses Legendary Resistance. (In the game this is the crippled phase below.)

traits.name: Consuming Flame
traits.summary: When it deals Fire damage it can make that damage Necrotic instead.
traits.text: Whenever the behemoth would deal Fire damage, it can choose to deal Necrotic damage instead.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day, or 5/Day in Lair)
traits.summary: 4 times a day (5 in its lair), a failed saving throw becomes a success.
traits.text: When it fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead, 4 times a day or 5 times in its lair.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.summary: Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.summary: Double damage against objects and structures.

traits.name: Tunneler
traits.summary: Burrows through solid rock at half its Burrow Speed, leaving a 20-ft-wide tunnel.
traits.text: It can burrow through solid rock at half its Burrow Speed and leaves a tunnel 20 feet across behind it.

traits.name: Regional Lair Effects
traits.summary: While it lives and keeps its lair, the land round it carries two effects: Relentless Blaze; Tenacious Lava.
traits.text: Relentless Blaze: within 10 miles of the lair, every hour a contained fire has a 10 percent chance to spread to a flammable object within 10 feet, and an uncontained fire is out of control in 10 minutes. Tenacious Lava: within 1 mile of the lair, a creature that takes damage from lava starts burning and takes 1d6 Fire instead of 1d4 each time it burns. Both end at once if the behemoth dies or moves its lair.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.summary: One Bite, and two attacks that are any mix of Claw and Blazing Boulder.

actions.name: Bite
actions.summary: +18, reach 15 ft, 3d10+10 Slashing plus 2d10 Fire; the target is Grappled and Restrained (escape DC 20).
actions.text: Fire-lit fangs: 26 (3d10 + 10) Slashing plus 11 (2d10) Fire damage. The target is Grappled (escape DC 20) and Restrained until the grapple ends.

actions.name: Blazing Boulder
actions.summary: +18, range 150 ft, 1d10+10 Bludgeoning plus 2d6 Fire; the target falls Prone.

actions.name: Cataclysmic Spellcasting
actions.summary: 1/day. Casts Earthquake and Meteor Swarm (Cha, no Material components, save DC 24).
actions.text: Once a day it casts Earthquake and Meteor Swarm, needing no Material components and using Charisma (spell save DC 24).

actions.name: Lava Well
actions.summary: Legendary only, once a round. Lava floods its space and the free spaces of its tunnels within 100 ft for an hour: 10d10 Fire the first time a creature touches it or starts its turn there each round.
actions.text: Lava covers the ground in the behemoth's space and in unoccupied spaces of any tunnel it dug within 100 feet. A creature that touches the lava for the first time on a turn, or starts its turn in it, takes 55 (10d10) Fire damage, once per round. The lava cools and hardens after 1 hour or when the behemoth uses this again. Not again until its next turn begins.

reactions.name: Hellish Rebuke
reactions.summary: Casts Hellish Rebuke when its trigger is met (Cha, save DC 24).

options.name: Lava Well
options.summary: Floods its space and its tunnels within 100 ft with lava: 10d10 Fire. Once a round.

options.name: Trample
options.summary: Moves up to half its Speed and makes one Claw attack; a creature it hits falls Prone.
options.text: It moves up to half its Speed and makes one Claw attack. On a hit against a creature, that creature is knocked Prone.

phases.name: Crippled by a Burning Sacrifice
phases.summary: A hero's willing death in fire or lava quenches its flame: it loses Legendary Resistance, moves at half Speed, becomes Vulnerable to Radiant and suffers Disadvantage on D20 Tests.
phases.text: Set by the story when a creature willingly gives its life in fire or lava to defeat the behemoth. The effect lasts 24 hours, which is the rest of the fight.

traits_add.name: Quenched Flame
traits_add.summary: Disadvantage on D20 Tests while crippled.
traits_add.text: While crippled by the sacrifice, the behemoth has Disadvantage on D20 Tests (attack rolls, saving throws and ability checks).

summary: An apocalyptic fiend of fire and brimstone: it tunnels through rock, bites and claws from 15 ft away, hurls burning boulders, floods its tunnels with lava and calls down Earthquake and Meteor Swarm.
